subject: V3 blocker: pure exact-current host/readiness/migration/refresh core is not wired into Android runtime
body: Static call-site audit of the exact V3 package finds the pure core APIs bindHost, beginHostMigration, stageIncomingHost, recordReceipt, migrationDecision, observeActualDisplayHz, observeMeasuredFrameHz and releaseRefresh are used only by the pure test harness/core, not by the Android adapter/service integration. Gen7AndroidCoordinator exposes diagnostic markReadiness/physical/logical/observeRefresh state, but the V3 patcher invokes only begin/advance, semantic ingress, renderFrame, privacy/video, observeRefresh and terminate. Therefore ordered exact-current readiness, make-before-break migration gating, content grant host binding, and refresh leases are not yet enforcing live Android transitions in V3. This matches the V3 report next-cycle note to complete exact-current host/readiness and refresh binding. Separate pure-core edge case also reproduced: after migration generation advance, startedNs/outgoing remain from the old generation; restaging a private fallback after 850ms can immediately return RETIRE_OUTGOING_PRIVATE_FROST_TIMEOUT. Disposition cannot be READY until runtime wiring is completed/reviewed and the generation-reset timeout semantics are resolved or explicitly justified/tested.
